# elemento_serverless (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code_zip_b64` (String) Base64-encoded zip archive of the function code.
- `environment` (Map of String) Environment variables passed to the function.
- `handler` (String) Entry point of the function.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the function URL is reachable from the public internet.
- `memory` (Number) Memory allocated to the function.
- `name` (String) Name of the function.
- `region` (String) Region to deploy in. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `runtime` (String) Function runtime.
- `timeout` (Number) Execution timeout of the function.

### Optional

- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period, e.g. `day`, `month` or `year`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID for the resource.
- `arn` (String) ARN of the resource.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type of the function URL.
- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `payment_url` (String) URL where the payment for the resource is completed.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key for the resource.
- `state` (String) Current state reported by the service.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `url` (String) Invocation URL of the function.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID.
